sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio and syndication, Jane Morgan in two tense Double X ranch domestic crises on *Aunt Mary* for Albers Milling (1946–1947), NBC's autumn 1953 executive closed-circuit affiliate preview feed, Western swing on *Chuck Wagon Jamboree*, and Westinghouse research scientists explaining radar innovations and John J. Montgomery glider experiments on *Adventures in Research* (1945–1953):
